scope.name: Universal Connectivity, Capture, Automation, and Integrations
scope.responsibility: Make Multiversal one interconnected system through quick capture, Search Everywhere, universal share/link/attach actions, Turn This Into, backlinks, governed macros, no-code automation, deep links, provider adapters, clerical AI assistance, and stable declarative extension points.
exit_criteria: Information can move between relevant Multiversal surfaces without manual re-entry.
Automation and AI assistance respect authority, permissions, provenance, privacy, and canonical state.
External integrations are replaceable adapters rather than sources of architectural lock-in.
Extensions expose explicit capabilities, permissions, dependencies, versions, compatibility ranges, and upgrade/rollback expectations.
Routine upgrades do not silently invalidate campaign-critical extensions or packs.

next_action: Implement scoped capture, search, references, governed automation and extension boundaries; validate/publish.
